implementation during 2023 is not shown.","ruler_attribution":"Government-reported constitutional and legislative arrangements; no direct personal attribution beyond the presidential-era legal framework.","limitations":["These are state submissions and do not independently verify actual independence, resources, or performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":126,"end_unit":127,"fact_summary":"The National Council for Persons with Disabilities was reported to propose policies and strategies, coordinate ministries, prepare annual reports for the President, Parliament, and Prime Minister, review disability complaints, notify authorities of rights violations, monitor implementation, and oversee disability organizations.","question_ids":["4B.4","6B.5","6B.8","6B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Describes the council's statutory or administrative functions before 2023;
